title: Executive Program in Technology Leadership & Innovation
description: Embark on a 9 month learning journey to lead innovation, leverage emerging technologies, and drive business growth.

content.title: who should join
points: Senior Technology Executives: Lead digital transformation and technology-driven business strategy
Technology Directors & Engineering Leaders: Align innovation with business goals and lead high-performing teams
Senior Managers & Technical Professionals: Strengthen leadership to drive innovation and scale technology initiatives
Founders & Entrepreneurs: Build and grow technology-led, future-ready businesses
Innovation & Digital Transformation Leaders: Accelerate organizational transformation through emerging technologies

content.title: program snapshot
points: 9 Modules: Strategic Leadership, Emerging Technologies and Innovation Frameworks
Campus Immersion: One 2-Day Campus Immersion at IIT Madras

curriculum.title: Strategic Communication & Boardroom Influence
points: Influencing CEOs, CFOs, COOs, and Business Leaders

curriculum.title: Technology Strategy & Competitive Advantage
points: Translating Business Strategy into Technology Architecture
Building Technology Moats Through Platforms, Data, and Ecosystems
Build vs Buy vs Partner vs Acquire: Strategic Technology Decisions

curriculum.title: Strategic Finance for Technology Leaders
points: CapEx vs OpEx Decision Frameworks for Technology Investments
Evaluating ROI Across Platforms, Products, and Infrastructure
Balancing Cost Optimization with Innovation Investments

curriculum.title: Enterprise Technology & Digital Architecture

curriculum.title: Leading Digital Transformation at Scale
points: Scaling Change Across Functions and Geographies

curriculum.title: AI & Generative AI Strategy

curriculum.title: Capstone Project
points: Participants will design a board-ready enterprise technology strategy for a real or simulated organization. The project integrates technology investment decisions, digital architecture choices, AI adoption strategy, innovation roadmap, and organizational design. Learners will present transformation priorities, value cases, risk governance, and execution model—demonstrating readiness to lead enterprise-wide technology-driven growth at the C-suite level.
